note.question: How should the best from a finite set of simulated alternatives, in the presence of such input uncertainty be selected?
note.overview: Specifying a proper input distribution is often a challenging task in simulation modeling. In practice, there may be multiple plausible distributions that can fit the input data reasonably well, especially when the data volume is not large. In this paper, we consider the problem of selecting the best from a finite set of simulated alternatives, in the presence of such input uncertainty.
